subject: General Knowledge
description: National + international days: history, date, theme, hit rate very high in SSC/banking

questions.stem: WORLD ENVIRONMENT DAY is observed every year on:
questions.explanation: 5 June — WED, instituted by UN General Assembly in 1972 marking the Stockholm Conference on the Human Environment. Earth Day is 22 April; World Ozone Day is 16 September; World Water Day is 22 March.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: NATIONAL SCIENCE DAY is celebrated in India on 28 February to commemorate:

options.option_text: Discovery of the Raman Effect by C.V. Raman

questions.explanation: C.V. Raman announced the discovery of the Raman Effect on 28 February 1928 — scattering of light revealing molecular structure. Won the Physics Nobel in 1930. NSD instituted in 1986.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Match the DAY with its DATE. A. International Women's Day. B. World Health Day. C. World Population Day. D. Human Rights Day. List-II: 1. 8 March. 2. 7 April. 3. 11 July. 4. 10 December.
questions.explanation: Women — 8 March. Health — 7 April (WHO founding day, 1948). Population — 11 July. Human Rights — 10 December (UDHR, 1948).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: INTERNATIONAL YOGA DAY is observed on:
questions.explanation: 21 June — summer solstice (longest day in the northern hemisphere). Proposed by PM Modi at UNGA 2014; first observed 21 June 2015. 21 July is falsely recalled by some students — the solstice date is 21 June.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: NATIONAL TEACHER'S DAY (India) is celebrated on 5 September to commemorate the birth of:
questions.explanation: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan — philosopher, India's 2nd President — born 5 September 1888. Himself a teacher, he asked that his birthday be marked as Teacher's Day from 1962. Nehru's birthday (14 November) is Children's Day.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Match each DAY with its THEME area. A. 8 March. B. 5 September. C. 14 November. D. 15 October. List-II: 1. International Women's Day. 2. Teacher's Day (India). 3. Children's Day (India). 4. World Students' Day (APJ Abdul Kalam's birthday).
questions.explanation: 8 March — IWD. 5 September — Teacher's Day (Radhakrishnan). 14 November — Children's Day (Nehru; 'Chacha Nehru'). 15 October — World Students' Day (APJ Abdul Kalam's birthday, announced by UN in 2010).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The UN's SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT GOALS (SDGs) were adopted in:
questions.explanation: SDGs: 17 goals, 169 targets, adopted in September 2015 at the UN; target year 2030 — 'Agenda 2030'. Replaced the Millennium Development Goals (2000-2015).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: UNITED NATIONS DAY is observed on:
questions.explanation: 24 October 1945 — UN Charter came into force. Hence UN Day. (10 December is Human Rights Day; 2 October is Gandhi Jayanti / International Day of Non-Violence.)
questions.subject: General Knowledge
